Name: Tree Shaker 1.6
Author: travlaney
Description:
This is an update for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2159]Tree Shaker[/url] mod, originally written by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TyoAtrosa/about-me?gameId=1303]TyoAtrosa[/url] and posted here with their permission.  It has been updated for Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+

From the original mod:
[quote]Multiplayer Friendly, only one player needs to have the mod for it to work, even if the host doesn't have it.

just place a chest to the right of your mailbox (or change the chest location in the config file) and in the morning every oak, pine, and maple tree seed on your farm will be picked up and placed in the chest. it's as simple as that. to stop the mod just pick the chest back up.

caution, picking up every seed from the ground every morning will cause you to be swimming in seeds very quickly. the upside is you can make Tons of granola bars.

Many thanks to Pathoschild and everyone from the discord that helped me with my very first mod and foray into C#! this would have never happened without you.[/quote]
[b]Default Coordinates[/b]
For most maps, the default coordinates (for the square just to the right of the mailbox) will be X=69, Y=16.
For the new Meadowlands Farm map, you will need to edit the Config.json file and change those coordinates to X=86, Y=20.

That said, you can put the chest anywhere, and on any map.  You will just have to change the (X,Y) coordinates in the Config.json file to the chest's new location.
